data.description: The S Slide turns twice on the way down, first one way and then the other, in a red S-shaped chute fed by a steel ladder. Those two turns make a 5 ft slide feel longer than a straight one, and children enjoy being swung from side to side. Its shape also gives the slide a distinct outline that stands out in a society garden or park. Because the exit ends up offset from the ladder, it can be fitted into an L-shaped corner of your site. The colour is Play Red. Our standard 3-year warranty applies to galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts. Send us your site plan and we will show the S Slide on a layout drawing.

items.pText: The S Slide turns twice on the way down, first one way and then the other, in a red S-shaped chute fed by a steel ladder. Those two turns make a 5 ft slide feel longer than a straight one, and children enjoy being swung from side to side. Its shape also gives the slide a distinct outline that stands out in a society garden or park. Because the exit ends up offset from the ladder, it can be fitted into an L-shaped corner of your site. The colour is Play Red. Our standard 3-year warranty applies to galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts. Send us your site plan and we will show the S Slide on a layout drawing.

The steel ladder is galvanised and the S-shaped bed is a weather-resistant moulding. Depending on the ground, our installers grout it or leave it self-standing. Allow for the full S-shaped footprint when planning your layout, keep a soft surface at the exit, and check the slide joints at each bend during maintenance.
